name: _get_subdocument
header:
def _get_subdocument(self, existing_document, spec, nested_field_list):
        """This method retrieves the subdocument of the existing_document.nested_field_list.

        It uses the spec to filter through the items. It will continue to grab nested documents
        until it can go no further. It will then return the subdocument that was last saved.
        '$' is the positional operator, so we use the $elemMatch in the spec to find the right
        subdocument in the array.
        """

[build-system]
requires = [ "hatchling", "hatch-vcs",]

[project]

dynamic = [ "version",]
description = "Fake pymongo stub for testing simple MongoDB-dependent code"
readme = "README.rst"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
classifiers = [ "License :: OSI Approved :: ISC License (ISCL)", "Topic :: Database", "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable", "Intended Audience :: Developers", "Operating System :: MacOS :: MacOS X", "Operating System :: Microsoft :: Windows", "Operating System :: POSIX", "Programming Language :: Python :: Implementation :: CPython", "Programming Language :: Python :: Implementation :: PyPy", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.9", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12", "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",]
dependencies = [ "packaging", "pytz", "sentinels", "pytest (>=8.4.2,<9.0.0)", "pytest-cov (>=7.0.0,<8.0.0)", "pytest-reportlog (>=0.4.0,<0.5.0)", "icontract (>=2.7.1,<3.0.0)", "pytest-env (>=1.2.0,<2.0.0)",]
version = "0.1.0"
[[project.authors]]
name = "Rotem Yaari"
email = "vmalloc@gmail.com"

[[project.authors]]
name = "Martin Domke"
email = "mail@martindomke.net"

[[project.authors]]

email = "pascal@corpet.net"

[project.license]

[project.optional-dependencies]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/mongomock/mongomock"

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py39"
line-length = 100

[tool.doc8]
max-line-length = 100

[tool.ruff.format]

[tool.ruff.lint]
extend-select = [ "A", "B", "C", "C4", "E", "F", "I", "N", "Q", "RUF", "S", "SIM", "T10", "UP", "W", "YTT",]
extend-fixable = [ "RUF100", "I001", "SIM300", "UP008", "UP003", "C403", "UP031", "UP032",]
extend-ignore = [ "A001", "A002", "A003", "FBT002", "N818", "UP006", "UP007", "PYI024", "S101", "ARG001", "ARG002", "DTZ001", "DTZ003", "DTZ004", "DTZ005", "EM101", "EM102", "TRY003", "PLR2004",]

[tool.hatch.version]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]

force-single-line = true

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-quotes]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [ "mongomock",]

postconds:
@icontract.snapshot(lambda parent_doc, subfield: parent_doc is not None)
@icontract.ensure(
    lambda parent_doc, subfield, existing_document, nested_field_list: 
    isinstance(parent_doc, (dict, list)) and 
    (isinstance(parent_doc, list) and isinstance(subfield, int) or 
     isinstance(parent_doc, dict) and subfield in parent_doc or 
     subfield == '_id') and 
    (parent_doc == existing_document or 
     any(isinstance(x, list) and subfield < len(x) for x in [parent_doc]) or 
     any(isinstance(x, dict) and subfield in x for x in [parent_doc]))
)
@icontract.ensure(
    lambda nested_field_list, parent_doc, subfield: 
    len(nested_field_list) > 0 and 
    (subfield == nested_field_list[-1] or 
     (isinstance(parent_doc, list) and subfield < len(parent_doc)) or 
     (isinstance(parent_doc, dict) and subfield in parent_doc))
)
